ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows a label 'Cricket' near the center. An arrow leads from the cricket toward the animal labeled 'frilled neck lizard' in the upper right. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows point from the food or prey to the organism that eats it. A predator is an animal that eats another animal. Since the frilled neck lizard is shown eating the cricket, the predator is the lizard.
